prompt_template.text:
Form the Sanskrit conjugated verb form described in this table.

Use the supplied Dhatupatha citation, including anubandha markers, verb class, traditional meaning, and any verbal prefixes. Apply the specified tense or mood, voice, person, and number.

| Grammatical input | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Verb in Dhatupatha citation form | {aupadeshika_deva}   (Dhatupatha citation form, anubandha markers included) |
| Verb class | {gana} ({gana_en}) |
| Traditional meaning | {artha_deva} |
| Tense or mood | {lakara} ({lakara_en}) |
| Voice | {prayoga} ({prayoga_en}) |
| Person | {purusha} ({purusha_en}) |
| Number | {vacana} ({vacana_en}) |

{prefixes_block}

Write ONLY the final form, in Devanagari script, inside exactly one
<answer></answer> block. If several forms are valid, give exactly one.
Do not include an explanation or any text outside the block:
<answer>Final form in Devanagari</answer>

scoring.answer_extraction: Extract exactly one well-formed literal <answer>...</answer> block and strip outer answer whitespace. No Unicode or orthographic normalization. Original text stays in output_text.
scoring.correct: For completed responses: answer is not null and answer in the source task.gold_devanagari list, joined by task_id. Otherwise null.
scoring.format_ok: Exactly one nonempty answer block, no nested markup, and only whitespace outside the block.
scoring.strict_accuracy: Derived when reporting: correct is true and format_ok. Not duplicated in result rows.
scoring.reporting: Report correctness and format separately, plus strict accuracy over all 20,000 tasks using the latest explicitly authorized settled attempt per task. Report refusals/incomplete/errors separately; never drop tasks from the denominator. Preserve first-attempt results in journals for separate analysis.
scoring.selected_attempt: Latest settled explicitly authorized attempt per task. User requested retrying all 14 connection failures and replacing selected outputs in place on 2026-10-15 UTC.

preservation.result_encoding: Compact UTF-8 JSON arrays, one selected row per task; bytes unchanged by cleanup.
preservation.selected_results: Latest authorized settled attempt. All prior attempts and costs remain in the archive.
preservation.raw_responses: Complete original journals, including request bodies, responses and original errors, are inside raw_run_archive.
preservation.recovery: Extract raw_run_archive into a separate directory to use the original journal-based verifier. Its original manifest and schema are preserved.
preservation.manifest_history: Historical manifest snapshots are retained verbatim; their paths describe the original execution layout.

request_input: Exact rendered prompt as one user message; no extra instructions, conversation history, tools, or model fallbacks.

output_limit.meaning: Anthropic requires max_tokens. Use the full supported model maximum, including thinking and answer tokens; no smaller benchmark cap.

comparison_run.meaning: Same four benchmark inputs, renderers and exact membership scorer as the completed Astra run. Prompt templates are pinned separately in tasks; Astra used v2.

schema.title: Compact Opus 5.5 xHigh benchmark family results (v2)
schema.description: One array per family; one row per task, selecting the latest explicitly authorized settled attempt. All earlier attempts remain in the journals.

task_id.description: Join to the original benchmark row for inputs and accepted answers.

output_text.description: Unmodified visible response text, including any available partial text.

correct.description: Exact membership in the source gold list for completed responses; null for other outcomes.

format_ok.description: One nonempty answer block; only whitespace outside; no nested markup.

usage.description: Full provider usage. Output length is usage.output_tokens; reasoning is its subset. Null when unavailable.

cost_usd.description: Usage-based estimate using the manifest rates; null when unknown.

error.description: Null on normal success; otherwise compact error/refusal/incomplete or unknown-cost details, preserving provider codes/messages.

rules: Anthropic cache counters are additional to input_tokens, not subsets.
Output usage includes hidden thinking; never add thinking tokens twice.
No-output refusals with empty content are unbilled except bio, frontier_llm and reasoning_extraction; mid-stream refusals are billed normally.
Interrupted streams have unknown final usage/cost, even when partial usage exists. Reserve their full possible charge.
Usage estimates exclude taxes, credits and invoice adjustments.

execution.budget_scope: Ceiling for this run using the user's earlier Anthropic budget. Account-wide remaining credit and prior pilot charges are not available locally.
execution.resume: Completed compact result export. Use the archived original execution directory for journal-based verification or recovery.
execution.failure_handling: Preserve transient failures without retrying; cool down before sending unrelated tasks. Rate limits reduce admission concurrency. Five consecutive transient failures pause for inspection.

recovery_events.action: Resume only unsent tasks after correcting the single-field run-control.json format. All 1123 submitted requests settled and verified; no retries.

runner_revisions.reason: Add explicit retry attempt tracking and preserve all-attempt cost accounting. Model settings and prompts unchanged.

retry_batches.authorization: Explicit user instruction to retry infrastructure failures and update selected result rows in place.

execution.explicit_retries: Explicitly authorized infrastructure retries replace the selected row in place. All attempts and charges remain in journals; no automatic retries.

manifest_history.reason: Preserve the completed primary v3 run before the user-authorized retry of 14 connection failures.

manifest.sampling_seed_scope: Dataset selection only; not a model-generation seed.

events.started: Before sending, append and fsync task_id, attempt_number, timestamp, client_request_id and exact request JSON including the hydrated prompt.
events.response: Before scoring, append and fsync task_id, attempt_number, request_id, elapsed_ms, timestamp and the complete unmodified terminal response.
events.error: Append task_id, attempt_number, request_id, timestamp, elapsed_ms, HTTP status, provider/client error details and available partial output; exclude credentials.

preservation.stream_handling: Consume events in memory. Preserve available partial text on handled interruption; do not permanently log individual events.
preservation.result_encoding: Compact UTF-8 JSON arrays; one compact record per line.
preservation.shared_metadata: Dataset/gold stay in pinned benchmark files. Model/settings/templates/rates/scoring version stay in this manifest; family comes from the result filename.
preservation.write_order: Durable started journal entry before send; durable response/error entry before scoring; atomically update family results after each settled attempt.
preservation.compression: Gzip each completed journal; remove the plain copy only after verifying the archive. Retain one archive per family.
preservation.recovery: Replay journals to rebuild results and reprice/rescore offline. Read completed .jsonl.gz archives as needed; do not resend completed attempts.
preservation.selected_results: One result row per task; latest explicitly authorized settled attempt. Journals retain every attempt and all costs.
